title: The McGavock Loft - Near Gaylord Opryland Hotel
description:
New loft apartment just 10 minutes from the airport, 3 minutes from The Opryland Hotel and Grand Ole Opry. 15 minutes from Downtown Nashville.

The space
The McGavock Loft was just completed and is ready for your enjoyment. Queen sized bed (Serra iComfort Hybrid Mattress), fold-out twin couch, mini fridge and freezer, microwave, Keurig coffee machine, nice bathroom with granite countertops. It is actually an apartment above the garage. It has a private entry and a lot of steps. Please no smoking or vaping on the property.

Guest access
Outdoor table and space available. Great evening sunsets! Private entry. Great parking close to the door.

Other things to note
We have had many great guests, but several not so great guests insisted on smoking in or around the property even after reading the no smoking request. An additional $75 fee will be charged if smoke smell is detected after the visit.
